findings.counterexample_cmd:
bash -c 'python3 - <<PY
import sqlite3
c=sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
c.executescript("CREATE TABLE issues(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,status TEXT,archived_at TEXT,last_seen_at TEXT)")
c.execute("INSERT INTO issues VALUES(?,?,?,?)",("i1","ignored",None,"2020-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"))
job="UPDATE issues SET archived_at=? WHERE status IN (?,?) AND archived_at IS NULL AND last_seen_at < ?"
cur="2026-09-25T00:00:00+00:00"
print("round1 archived", c.execute(job,("2026-10-25T19:00:00+00:00","ignored","resolved",cur)).rowcount)
c.execute("UPDATE issues SET archived_at=NULL WHERE id=?",("i1",))
print("after unarchive", c.execute("SELECT archived_at FROM issues").fetchone())
print("round2 archived", c.execute(job,("2026-10-25T19:00:01+00:00","ignored","resolved",cur)).rowcount)
PY'
findings.detail: C2.3 只冻结「重复归档 archived_at 不变」的单向幂等，没有 unarchive 的持久性/抑制规则：TTL 判据仍是 status∈{ignored,resolved} AND archived_at IS NULL AND last_seen_at<cutoff，手动 unarchive 后下一轮（生产 3600s）即被重新归档，恢复语义被作业静默覆盖。

findings.counterexample_cmd:
bash -c 'python3 - <<PY
import sqlite3,tempfile,os
p=tempfile.mktemp(suffix=".db")
a=sqlite3.connect(p,timeout=0); b=sqlite3.connect(p,timeout=0)
a.executescript("CREATE TABLE issues(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,status TEXT,archived_at TEXT,last_seen_at TEXT)")
a.execute("INSERT INTO issues VALUES(?,?,?,?)",("i1","ignored",None,"2020-01-01T00:00:00+00:00")); a.commit()
sel="SELECT id FROM issues WHERE status IN (?,?) AND archived_at IS NULL"
upd="UPDATE issues SET archived_at=? WHERE status IN (?,?) AND archived_at IS NULL"
matched=len(a.execute(sel,("ignored","resolved")).fetchall()); print("A matched",matched)
nb=b.execute(upd,("2026-10-25T19:00:00+00:00","ignored","resolved")).rowcount; b.commit(); print("B archived",nb)
na=a.execute(upd,("2026-10-25T19:00:00+00:00","ignored","resolved")).rowcount
print("A archived",na,"skipped_already",0,"invariant_holds",matched==na+0+0)
os.unlink(p)
PY'
findings.detail: C2.4 把 matched==archived+skipped_already_archived+skipped_not_archivable 定为硬不变式，却未要求计数与 UPDATE 同语句/同快照产生：TTL 作业与手动批量（或两路手动）并发时 READ COMMITTED 下必然出现 matched=1、archived=0、skipped_*=0。

findings.counterexample_cmd:
bash -c 'python3 - <<PY
import sqlite3
c=sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
c.executescript("CREATE TABLE issues(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,status TEXT,count INT,archived_at TEXT,last_seen_at TEXT); CREATE TABLE events(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,issue_id TEXT,created_at TEXT)")
c.execute("INSERT INTO issues VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)",("i1","resolved",3,"2026-10-01T00:00:00+00:00","2026-10-01T00:00:00+00:00"))
c.execute("UPDATE issues SET count=count+1, status=CASE WHEN status=? THEN ? ELSE status END, last_seen_at=? WHERE id=?",("resolved","regression","2026-10-25T19:00:00+00:00","i1"))
c.execute("INSERT INTO events VALUES(?,?,?)",("e1","i1","2026-10-25T19:00:00+00:00"))
print("row",c.execute("SELECT status,count,archived_at,last_seen_at FROM issues").fetchone())
print("default list rows",c.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM issues WHERE archived_at IS NULL").fetchone()[0])
print("ttl re-archive candidates",c.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM issues WHERE status IN (?,?) AND archived_at IS NULL",("ignored","resolved")).fetchone()[0])
PY'
findings.detail: 归档只写 archived_at，而 ingest 对已归档 issue 仍 count+1、last_seen_at 前移并做 resolved→regression 跃迁（F17）：产出 archived_at 非空 + status=regression 的活跃僵尸且被默认列表/统计隐藏，契约既无「新事件自动 unarchive」也无「归档 issue 停收/跳过 events」条款，属未显式化的设计缺口。

bash -c 'python3 - <<PY
import sqlite3
c=sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
c.executescript("CREATE TABLE issues(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,count INT,archived_at TEXT); CREATE TABLE events(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,issue_id TEXT)")
c.execute("INSERT INTO issues VALUES(?,?,?)",("i1",3,"2026-10-02T00:00:00+00:00"))
c.execute("INSERT INTO issues VALUES(?,?,?)",("i2",2,None))
for e in ["e1","e2","e3"]: c.execute("INSERT INTO events VALUES(?,?)",(e,"i1"))
for e in ["e4","e5"]: c.execute("INSERT INTO events VALUES(?,?)",(e,"i2"))
q=lambda s: c.execute(s).fetchone()[0]
print("issues.total(exclude archived)",q("SELECT count(*) FROM issues WHERE archived_at IS NULL"))
print("events.total=SUM(count) under issue filter",q("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(count),0) FROM issues WHERE archived_at IS NULL"))
print("events.stored_rows(archived rule unstated)",q("SELECT count(*) FROM events"))
print("sum(series.events) row-scoped",q("SELECT count(*) FROM events"))
PY'
findings.detail: C5 只对 issues.by_* 闭合了 ==total，events.total(SUM count, issue 维度)/stored_rows(COUNT(*))/by_level|by_release(行口径)/series[].events 的 from-to 与 archived 作用域未定义：归档瞬间 issues.total 与 events.total 同步下降，而 stored_rows/series 是否下降无判据，同一响应内三套口径无法互相校验。

import sqlite3
c=sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
c.executescript("CREATE TABLE events(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,issue_id TEXT,created_at TEXT NOT NULL)")
c.execute("INSERT INTO events VALUES(?,?,?)",("idA","i1","2026-10-25T19:00:00.123456789+00:00"))
c.execute("INSERT INTO events VALUES(?,?,?)",("idB","i1","2026-10-25T19:00:00.123456500+00:00"))
print("page1(limit=1)",c.execute("SELECT id FROM events WHERE issue_id=? ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1",("i1",)).fetchall())
cur="2026-10-25T19:00:00.123456+00:00"
print("page2(cursor from truncated micros)",c.execute("SELECT id FROM events WHERE issue_id=? AND created_at < ? ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC",("i1",cur)).fetchall())
print("total rows",c.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM events").fetchone()[0])
PY'
findings.detail: 游标只携带 created_at_micros，但 SQLite 侧 events.created_at 由 to_rfc3339() 落 TEXT 且保留纳秒（crates/core/src/sqlite_repository.rs:451 未做 to_micros，PG :396 做了），同微秒地板内更早的行会被 created_at < cursor 排除——C4.2「翻页不重不漏」在 SQLite 上确定失效。

findings.counterexample_cmd:
bash -c 'python3 - <<PY
import sqlite3,tempfile,os
p=tempfile.mktemp(suffix=".db")
c1=sqlite3.connect(p,timeout=0,isolation_level=None)
c2=sqlite3.connect(p,timeout=0,isolation_level=None)
c1.executescript("CREATE TABLE ingest_metrics(bucket_date TEXT NOT NULL, project TEXT NOT NULL, outcome TEXT NOT NULL, count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(bucket_date,project,outcome))")
ups="INSERT INTO ingest_metrics (bucket_date,project,outcome,count,updated_at) VALUES (?,?,?,1,?) ON CONFLICT (bucket_date,project,outcome) DO UPDATE SET count = ingest_metrics.count + 1, updated_at = excluded.updated_at"
c1.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
try:
    c2.execute(ups,("2026-10-25","","received","2026-10-25T19:00:00Z")); print("second writer ok")
except sqlite3.OperationalError as e:
    print("second writer dropped under warn_only ->",e)
c1.execute("COMMIT")
c2.execute(ups,("2026-10-25","","received","2026-10-25T19:00:00Z"))
c2.execute(ups,("2026-10-25","","received","2026-10-25T19:00:00Z"))
print("count after two accepted upserts",c2.execute("SELECT count FROM ingest_metrics").fetchone()[0])
os.unlink(p)
PY'
findings.detail: C6.2 把 UPSERT SQL 冻结成 PG 方言（$1..$4/now()）且未给 SQLite 等价语句（C1.2 只给 DDL）；SQLite 并发写触发 SQLITE_BUSY 时按 warn_only 丢弃计数，A9「上报后 received+1」不确定，且全文没有 received >= created+duplicate 不变式。

events 仅有 idx_events_issue_id（migrations/0001_init.sql:29、postgres/0001_init.sql:28），C4 未要求 (issue_id, created_at, id) 索引、也未固定 id 的 text 比较 collation（PG 默认排序规则 vs SQLite BINARY），keyset「全局唯一且与索引一致」只在逻辑上成立，跨方言顺序与代价无判据。

findings.counterexample_cmd: bash -c 'grep -nE "退避|backoff|重试|retry|首轮失败|归档作业.*迁移.*(之后|完成)" .dev-team/contract-issue-governance.md; echo "grep_exit=$? (1 = 无退避/无首轮顺序条款)"'
findings.detail: C2.2 只说「启动后立即跑首轮」，未规定必须在 migrate() 成功返回之后、也无失败退避/立即重试：首轮若撞上 0007 未生效（archived_at 缺列）或 SQLITE_BUSY，warn 后要等一整个 INTERVAL（生产 3600s）才重试，形成静默空窗。

bash -c 'python3 - <<PY
import json
d=json.load(open(".dev-team/nfr-baseline.json"))
print("ingest timeout keys:",[k for k in d if "ingest" in k and "timeout" in k])
print("sibling bounds:",d.get("trace_write_tx_timeout_ms"),d.get("trace_lock_timeout_ms"))
print("missing ingest_metrics write bound:", not any("ingest" in k and "timeout" in k for k in d))
PY'
findings.detail: 每事件 UPSERT 是 ingest 同步路径上的写且 PK(bucket_date,project,outcome) 是单热行，基线只登记 failure_policy，没有 ingest_metrics 的 write tx/lock 超时档（兄弟 trace 写有 trace_write_tx_timeout_ms=3000/trace_lock_timeout_ms=2000），external_call_timeout_ms 不覆盖 DB，ingest 延迟上界无判据。
